title: Change keyboard layout on Linux
summary: Use setxkbmap to switch your keyboard layout (e.g., to French or German) or set up multiple layouts with a switching key. This applies changes immediately for the current X11 session.

steps.explain: Set the keyboard layout to a specific language code (e.g., 'fr' for French, 'de' for German).

placeholders.name: LAYOUT_CODE
placeholders.description: The ISO code for the desired keyboard layout (e.g., us, fr, de, ru).

steps.explain: Configure multiple layouts (e.g., US and German) with specific variants and a key combination to switch between them.

placeholders.name: VARIANTS
placeholders.description: Comma-separated list of variants for each layout (empty for default).

placeholders.name: SWITCH_OPTION
placeholders.description: The option to switch layouts, e.g., 'grp:alt_caps_toggle'.
